properties.name: Essex County, Ontario, with its waters
properties.source: The land line Essex County shares with Chatham-Kent: GADM 3.6 level 2 (Ontario), via github.com/stephanietuerk/admin-boundaries lo-res/Admin2_simp05. Carried out to the international boundary across Lake St Clair (straight from the north end to the St Clair River where its last bend south-west begins (owner, Oct 7: the line to the South Channel elbow made a V; this way river and lake line run on nearly straight, and the delta's western islands, Walpole Island, go with Essex)) and across Lake Erie (from the south end, due south, at right angles to the boundary there), so Essex takes the Canadian water on its side (the Detroit River, Lake St Clair west of that line, western Lake Erie with Pelee Island). Past the boundary the shape runs on over US ground and water, which it never cuts: only the province's own land (CA-ON) is cut by it.
